snippet.title: D.Mon | New Hero Gameplay Trailer | Overwatch
snippet.description:
Get ready for a Hero of MEKA proportions with the arrival of D.Mon!

Former pro gamer Yuna Lee finally joins the roster as our newest Tank Hero. Piloting her mech, Beast, D.Mon slices through her enemies up close with her Plasma Saber and defends her team using her Power Barrier.

Activate her Propulsors to quickly maneuver the battlefield, fire up her Fusion Repeater for added pressure on the enemy team, and set your team up for success when you unleash her Ultimate, Limit Break.

Similar to D.Va, you’ll also be able to eject from D.Mon’s mech when you’ve taken too much damage and call it back when you’re ready for the next team fight.

Suit up and take charge when Season 4: Heroes of Busan launches on Aug 11.

Overwatch is free to play on PC and console, now including Nintendo Switch™ 2"!
_

snippet.title: KAROL G - Si lo ven (Visualizer)
snippet.description:
Escucha / Stream ‘NO ME ARREPIENTO DE SENTIR TANTO’ on your favorite platform: https://KarolG.lnk.to/NMADST 
Subscribe to my YouTube channel here: https://karolg.lnk.to/SubscribeKarolGYT 

Connect with KAROL G:  
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/karolg/  
X: https://twitter.com/karolg  
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@karolg  
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/KarolGOficial 

LYRICS: 
No sé a quién le miento  
Si se me nota que todavía extraño, que todavía siento   

Últimamente estoy saliendo más 
Pero no me divierto   
Si me ven sonriendo   
Es porque aparento  

No sé a quién le miento  
Subiendo historias como si estuviera en mi mejor momento 
Pero to’ el que me conoce bien sabe que estoy fingiendo  
Por fuera sonriendo, por dentro muriendo  

Si lo ven díganle que estoy bien  
Qué nunca ha estado mejor  
Qué ya lo superé  
Aunque él sabe que no  

Si lo ven díganle que sané  
Qué por fin lo olvidé 
Miéntanle por favor  

Si lo ven no le digan que yo aún lo lloro  
Sigo cuidando la herida por el abandono  
Qué sólo quiero estar sola  
Qué no me enamoro 

Qué ya no puedo querer  
Pero que a él lo adoro  

No quiero que se dé cuenta  
Que el control que tenía sobre mí 
Todavía me enfrenta  

El ya hizo su vida 
Y yo aquí sigo quieta 
Por qué no confío en nadie que me presentan  

Extraño a veces verlo  
Pero eso no está bien  
Mucho cuesta entenderlo  
Lo tengo que soltar  
Maldita dependencia  
Me dejó vuelta nada  

Si lo ven díganle lo que estoy bien  
Que nunca que nunca ha estado mejor  
Que ya lo superé  
Aunque él sabe que no  

Si lo ven díganle que sané 
Que por fin lo olvidé 
Miéntale por favor 
 

#KAROLG #NMADST #Siloven

snippet.title: One Night Only | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
what would you do if you only had one night?

__________________________________________________________

What if one messy night turns out to be the best thing that ever happened to you?  

This summer, Will Gluck, the filmmaker of Anyone but You and Easy A, celebrates modern romantic comedy on the big screen with a fresh, witty, swoony original film about searching for love on the least romantic night of the year.  

Academy Award® nominee Monica Barbaro (A Complete Unknown, Top Gun: Maverick) and BAFTA nominee Callum Turner (Masters of the Air, Fantastic Beasts franchise) star as Allie and Owen, two love-starved strangers who crash into each other in an ever-so-slightly fictionalized New York City on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex. 

Recently dumped Owen and hopeful romantic Allie might be the only two singles in the city looking for more than just a quick encounter. They both feel a spark when they meet, but a series of missteps and side quests complicate their night, keeping them apart. As they each race toward and away from each other across the city, they just might discover that the one thing they want most is closer than they think. 

The film’s electrifying cast includes Maya Hawke (Stranger Things), Julia Fox (Uncut Gems), indie pop sensation King Princess (Nine Perfect Strangers), Ben Marshall (Saturday Night Live), Ziwe (Baited with Ziwe), Ella Loudon (Can’t Let it Go) and screen legends Molly Ringwald and Levar Burton. 

One Night Only is directed and produced by Will Gluck, from a script by Travis Braun. The film is produced by Will Gluck through his company Olive Bridge Entertainment, and by Olive Bridge VP Jacqueline Monetta (exec producer, Anyone but You).


Follow us on Facebook at https://www.facebook.com/onenightonlymovie
Find us on Instagram at https://www.instagram.com/onenightonlymovie/
Follow us on X at https://x.com/1nightonlymovie
https://onenightonlymovie.com/
#OneNightOnly

Director:  Will Gluck 
Written by:  Travis Braun  
Producers: Will Gluck, Jacqueline Monetta

snippet.title: Quake: Dawn of the Machine — Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Quake™: Dawn of the Machine is available now!  

To celebrate Quake’s 30th anniversary, the award-winning team at MachineGames—in collaboration with id Software—returns with Dawn of the Machine, a brutal new episode building on their critically acclaimed work on Dimension of the Machine and Dimension of the Past. Delivering ferocious combat, labyrinthine level design, and nightmarish realms that twist reality beyond recognition, it pushes the legacy of the genre-defining first-person shooter even further, honoring one of gaming’s most enduring icons.  

  

END THE NIGHTMARE. ESCAPE THE ILLUSION  

Ranger is trapped in a dimension of endless illusion, reliving the same violent cycles for what feels like lifetimes, dying thousands of times in a futile attempt to escape. Wearied but unbroken, he has heard rumor of The Nightmare Machine.   

Beyond the hordes of monsters, twisted by an eternity in the Elder realms, lies the Machine. It is believed its destruction will shatter the illusion, finally breaking the loop.   

 

For more information on Quake, follow these channels:  

X:   / quake    

Instagram:   / quake    

Facebook:   / quake   

TikTok:   / bethesda   

 

Website: https://bethesda.net/en/game/quake  

 

ESRB RATING: Mature for Blood and Gore and Intense Violence.

snippet.title: THE ONLY LIVING PICKPOCKET IN NEW YORK | Official Trailer (2026)
snippet.description:
A love-letter to New York City. Watch the official trailer for THE ONLY LIVING PICKPOCKET IN NEW YORK. 

Opens in NY & LA theaters October 23, nationwide October 30. 

Directed by: Noah Segan
Starring: John Turturro, Giancarlo Esposito, Will Price, Tatiana Maslany, Victoria Moroles, Steve Buscemi, and Jamie Lee Curtis

Harry Lehman (John Turturro) is an aging pickpocket who plies his trade with ever-diminishing returns in a drastically changed New York. Wallets stuffed with cash have been replaced by easily canceled credit cards, and Harry struggles to make ends meet as he cares for his disabled wife, Rosie. When he unwittingly purloins and fences a valuable USB stick, Harry finds himself in a race against time to return the loot or face the rage of a vengeful crime family.

LETRA:
¿Siéndole fiel a qué, o más bien, a costa de qué?
Maldita monogamia, me parece una infamia
el dejarnos ya de ver.

Yo me quedo, tú te vas, o quizá es al revés
Al fin eso que importa, siendo la vida tan corta
tal vez más de lo que crees.

Me voy a seguir quedando con las reglas no escritas,
siendo el beso que no pides, pero el que más necesitas.
Por ahora ese seré, hasta que recuerdes
cómo ser mujer.

Vamos a acabar cediendo, porque tú no quieres irte,
y yo me voy a quedar porque tú no sabes rendirte,
ni yo dar paso pa’ atrás
porque si no, sé que las ganas no van a dejarte en paz.

No nacimos pa’ cobardes, ni para cumplir la ley,
yo no me bajo de este avión, ni aunque se declaré en Mayday,
valora posibilidades, y es que a nuestros ideales
no conviene serle infiel.

snippet.title: Dalvin La Melodia - Duele (Video Oficial)
snippet.description:
STREAM: https://sym.ffm.to/dalvin

Dalvin La Melodía presenta el video oficial de "Duele", el sencillo principal de su primer álbum de estudio, La Bachata Volvió. Una bachata que transmite el dolor de un amor perdido con una interpretación llena de sentimiento y una producción que honra la esencia del género mientras conecta con una nueva generación de oyentes.

"Duele" representa el inicio de una nueva etapa en la carrera de Dalvin La Melodía y forma parte de un proyecto que busca seguir llevando la bachata a lo más alto, con colaboraciones importantes y una propuesta musical auténtica.

Disfruta del video oficial y acompáñame en este nuevo capítulo de mi carrera.

snippet.description:

I wanted every shiny Pokémon to feel special, so I started a new save file with the goal of getting every Shiny Pokémon before ranking up in the Z-A royale, which became the longest adventure I've ever gone on.

This video is dedicated to my Mom. Without you, I wouldn't be the person that I am today.

snippet.title: 劇場シリーズ【第一部】メイドインアビス 目覚める神秘｜本予告
snippet.description:
『劇場シリーズ【第一部】メイドインアビス 目覚める神秘 』
2026年10月23日（金）公開！

ムビチケカード販売中！
https://miabyss.com/movie_part1/ticket.html

＜イントロダクション＞
隅々まで探索されつくした世界に、唯一残された秘境の大穴『アビス』。
どこまで続くとも知れない深く巨大なその縦穴には、奇妙奇怪な生物たちが生息し、
今の人類では作りえない貴重な遺物が眠っている。
「アビス」の不可思議に満ちた姿は人々を魅了し、冒険へと駆り立てた。
そうして幾度も大穴に挑戦する冒険者たちは、次第に『探窟家』と呼ばれるようになっていった。
アビスの縁に築かれた街『オース』に暮らす孤児のリコは、いつか母のような偉大な探窟家になり、アビスの謎を解き明かすことを夢見ていた。
ある日、母・ライザの白笛が発見されたことをきっかけに、アビスの奥深くへ潜ることを決意するリコ。リコに拾われた記憶喪失のロボット・レグも自分の記憶を探しに一緒に行くことを決意する。
深界四層で猛獣タマウガチの毒に苦しむリコ。リコを救ったのは成れ果てのナナチだった。ナナチを仲間に加え、ボンドルドの待つ深界五層へと三人は冒険を進める。
そこで、出会ったプルシュカと名乗る女の子は、ボンドルドに育てられ外界を知らずにいた。
リコの冒険話に夢中になり一緒に冒険に行きたいと願うが、あえなくボンドルドの実験に利用されてしまう。
しかし、プルシュカは形を変えリコの白笛となり、一同は深界六層「還らずの都」へと進む。
そこには、成れ果てが独自の価値観を持って生活している「成れ果ての村」と、姫・ファプタが存在していた。ファプタの「願い」によって解放された村は崩壊し、リコたちはファプタを誘い、深界七層へと進むのであった。

「アビス」の不可思議に満ちた姿は人々を魅了し、冒険へと駆り立てた。
そうして幾度も大穴に挑戦する冒険者たちは、次第に『探窟家』と呼ばれるようになっていった。
アビスの縁に築かれた街『オース』に暮らす孤児のリコは、いつか母のような偉大な探窟家になり、アビスの謎を解き明かすことを夢見ていた。
ある日、母・ライザの白笛が発見されたことをきっかけに、アビスの奥深くへ潜ることを決意するリコ。リコに拾われた記憶喪失のロボット・レグも自分の記憶を探しに一緒に行くことを決意する。
深界四層で猛獣タマウガチの毒に苦しむリコ。リコを救ったのは成れ果てのナナチだった。ナナチを仲間に加え、ボンドルドの待つ深界五層へと三人は冒険を進める。
そこで、出会ったプルシュカと名乗る女の子は、ボンドルドに育てられ外界を知らずにいた。
リコの冒険話に夢中になり一緒に冒険に行きたいと願うが、あえなくボンドルドの実験に利用されてしまう。
しかし、プルシュカは形を変えリコの白笛となり、一同は深界六層「還らずの都」へと進む。
そこには、成れ果てが独自の価値観を持って生活している「成れ果ての村」と、姫・ファプタが存在していた。ファプタの「願い」によって解放された村は崩壊し、リコたちはファプタを誘い、深界七層へと進むのであった。

snippet.description:
[LYRICS BELOW] Do you believe in the phrase "Happy Wife, Happy Life?" Let's discuss. I'm praying this reaches those who need it and creates an honest discussion.

LYRICS:

I gave you flowers 
but you never planted seeds
I give you time and spend it 
you think that it’s free
I gave you diamonds 
with a wedding and a ring
you fell in love with them
And never really married me
Your rainbow never leads to a pot of gold
No point of getting you a house
If you can’t turn it to a home
I’m tired of getting everything you want
I’m breaking free
I can’t give you what you want
But I can give you what you need

Unrealistic expectations
is what you have 
and what I’m done chasing 
you play your cards 
I grant you patience
You showed your hand
And now I’m done waiting
You always cry when I don’t buy
Your fireworks are like the Fourth of July
I gave you wings and now you fly
And claim I changed and I’m not your type
Fool me once if you do it again
I’ll pay the price with common sense
Your thin ice pushed me right to the edge
Girl this ain’t love if there ain’t no respect

I gave you flowers 
but you never planted seeds
I give you time and spend it 
you think that it’s free
I gave you diamonds 
with a wedding and a ring
you fell in love with them
And never really married me
Your rainbow never leads to a pot of gold
No point of getting you a house
If you can’t turn it to a home
I’m tired of getting everything you want
I’m breaking free
I can’t give you what you want
But I can give you what you need

No more shopping sprees 
or spa trips with your friends 
no more swiping my card 
watching Hollywood stars 
trying to keep up with all of the trends
no more male friends 
I can’t stand those guys 
who fake and try to pretend 
like they wouldn’t touch on ya
if given the chance 
to take my place and get you out your pants
I’m praying for us 
to make it through rainy days
I made a vow 
my commitment will never change 
a happy life is a choice that you gotta make 
cause happiness comes from giving 
not what you take 
don’t wanna hurt you 
just need you to understand 
that picture perfect life they’re posting 
is fake on your Instagram 
stop buying tickets to their circus 
comparing what you’re worth is
I’m breaking these chains 
off my feet and chasing purpose

I gave you flowers 
but you never planted seeds
I give you time and spend it 
you think that it’s free
I gave you diamonds 
with a wedding and a ring
you fell in love with them
And never really married me
Your rainbow never leads to a pot of gold
No point of getting you a house
If you can’t turn it to a home
I’m tired of getting everything you want
I’m breaking free
I can’t give you what you want
But I can give you what you need

I'm the lines of communication between the two is one of my over arching goals. This song is another brick laid and I want to thank anyone who takes the time to like, comment, and most importantly SHARE! This is and will always be music for the people, spread BY THE PEOPLE. Love you all and please take the time to check out the full ALBUM "Anger Management".

On this channel, you’ll find long-form video essays about gaming’s biggest stories from studio collapses and corporate greed to the creative risks that still push the medium forward. I break down industry trends, publisher decisions, and the economics behind how games are made, marketed, and sold.

Whether it’s GTA 6, Elden Ring, Baldur's Gate 3, Path of Exile 2, Call of Duty, Battlefield, Pokémon, or the next doomed live-service experiment, I cover how the industry’s biggest names keep shaping and breaking the games we play. 

From deep dive analysis on publishers like EA, Bungie, Blizzard, Activision, Ubisoft, Sony, and Microsoft to commentary on indie hits like Palworld and Expedition 33, every video cuts through the marketing to get to what actually matters: how this industry works, who it’s failing, and why players deserve better.

snippet.title: Can You Beat Baldi's Basics in CHAOS MODE?
snippet.description:
Baldi's Basics In Education and Learning is a game not many people are good at. Like, at all. The average YouTuber will probably get overwhelmed with the 7 characters found in the schoolhouse and say the game is the hardest thing ever (it's really not!). So, I wanted to make the game as difficult as everyone else makes it out to be, and try to complete all 3 main styles of Baldi's Basics Classic Remastered in Chaos Mode, a mode that adds a new set of characters for every notebook collected, totaling out to 56 CHARACTERS TOTAL. There's 8 Baldis, 8 Principals, 8 Playtimes, etc. This was not fun. At all. The things I do for love, am I right? Welp, at least I'm not stuck playing Hello Neighbor again. Or Poppy Playtime, Markiplier said that game was bad so I wont touch it probably, I'm a pathetic little sheep who gets their opinions from YouTubers, I know I'm awful. Anyways will I beat the challenge or not? Stay tuned!
